h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ajmer

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ajmer

items.pText: Ajmer draws pilgrims all year to the Dargah, and visitors heading on to Pushkar pass through as well. That keeps the town's hotels, guest houses and dharamshalas busy with families. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Ajmer to these properties and to the town's schools and housing colonies. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 810 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer.

A hotel or guest house rarely has a big lawn. More often there is a courtyard, a terrace garden or a corner beside the parking area. That calls for a small, well-chosen set, such as a compact multi play station or two or three individual pieces, placed where parents can watch. Ajmer is hot and dry for much of the year, and dust blows in from the Aravalli hills. We suggest a surface that is easy to sweep and pieces with smooth roto-moulded parts that wipe clean quickly.

richText.heading: Small play corners for Ajmer's hotels and guest houses

c: For a courtyard of modest size, a small multi play station from

combines a slide, steps and a deck in one footprint. Spring riders and a see-saw add play for younger children without much extra space. Keep the play corner away from the gate and vehicle movement, and mark its edge with a low fence or planter.
In the dry months, dust and grit gather on slides and steps, so a quick daily wipe keeps them pleasant to use. Our

items.q: Can you fit a play area into a hotel courtyard in Ajmer?
items.a: Yes, if the courtyard has space for the safe play area around each piece. Send us its length, width and a few photos. We will suggest compact equipment and show it on a layout drawing.

items.q: How do we keep playground equipment clean in dusty weather?
items.a: Wipe slides, steps and handholds with a damp cloth regularly in the dry months. Roto-moulded plastic has a smooth surface that cleans easily, and rubber flooring can be swept and washed.

items.q: Can the equipment be installed on an existing paved courtyard?
items.a: Some pieces can be installed self-standing on a firm, level paved surface. Others need grouting into a concrete base. We confirm this for each piece once we see your photos.
